schema: recipe command partitions; no runtime generator

selectionRules.head: Choose independently; supplies skin/hair ramps, face/hair and neutral eyes/mouth.
selectionRules.top: Choose top+secondary+sleeves+hands+garment neutral details together. Hands use selected head skin ramp.
selectionRules.bottom: Choose bottoms+exposed leg skin together. Calves use selected head skin ramp.
selectionRules.shoes: Choose independently at identical pose registration.
selectionRules.shadow: Keep one pose-appropriate shadow; seated furniture supplies it.
